claims: Charles Lee is the head coach of the Charlotte Hornets.
Charles Lee took the head coach position of the Charlotte Hornets in May 2024.
Charles Lee served as a top assistant coach with the Boston Celtics.
Charles Lee served as a top assistant coach with the Milwaukee Bucks.
Charles Lee was an assistant coach for the Boston Celtics (2023–24).
Charles Lee was an assistant coach for the Milwaukee Bucks (2018–2023).
Charles Lee starred at Bucknell University.
Charles Lee played in the NBA's Patriot League.
Charles Lee won an NBA championship with the Milwaukee Bucks in 2021.
Charles Lee is head coach of the Charlotte Hornets (2024–present).
